method: Classify each official feedback, audience, asset or governance surface by unit and documented movement boundary. Reviewed Help pages do not constitute a representative creator or viewer sample.
population: YouTube creators, viewers, subscribers and channel delegates; no sampled economic-outcome cohort

surfaces.title: Video comments, hearts and pins
surfaces.mechanism: Creators can review, reply, heart, pin, remove or hold video comments.
surfaces.limit: Visible feedback is moderated, not a verified purchase review or representative audience sample.

surfaces.title: Live chat and Community posts
surfaces.mechanism: YouTube Studio supports controls for live chat, comments and community posts.
surfaces.limit: Published community participation is not a deduplicated population or loyalty probability.

surfaces.title: Channel subscriptions
surfaces.mechanism: Studio distinguishes subscriber relationships from active viewers.
surfaces.limit: Subscribers are not consenting off-platform contacts, guaranteed views or paying buyers.

surfaces.title: Monthly and returning viewers
surfaces.mechanism: Studio displays estimated monthly, new, returning and regular viewers.
surfaces.limit: Aggregated owner analytics do not provide the identities of reachable customers.

surfaces.title: Uploaded creator video files
surfaces.mechanism: Studio and Google Takeout can download eligible creator uploads.
surfaces.limit: Copying videos does not transfer their recommendation history, subscriber relationships or earnings.

surfaces.title: Brand Account channel moves
surfaces.mechanism: A channel may be moved to an eligible Brand Account with a documented deletion risk.
surfaces.limit: This is an internal YouTube transfer, not cross-platform export or assignment of a commercial contract.

surfaces.title: Studio collaborator permissions
surfaces.mechanism: YouTube Studio grants role-limited access without sharing a Google password.
surfaces.limit: Delegation is not channel sale, copyright transfer or portable social reputation.

measurement_requirements: Sample a defined entry cohort including inactive and zero-engagement channels.
Separate visible from held, deleted or moderated comments; never infer unbiased sentiment.
Use comparable dated view, subscriber and unique-audience denominators.
Document consented off-platform reach and measured actual migration rather than assuming subscribers follow.
Separate downloadable creator-owned videos, within-platform account movement and delegated staff access.
Measure actual labor/cash interruption and net revenue before inferring switching costs.
limitations: No documented off-platform follower export is not a proof no conceivable lawful transfer mechanism exists.
Comments are not a transaction-verified buyer sample.
A Brand Account move is not a cross-platform move.
Public engagement is not verified creator profit.
